VPS / VM Hosting

Virtual servers, managed through a dedicated portal

HDXCLOUD provides a separate portal for VPS and VM services. Available configurations, operating systems, and resources are listed directly inside the panel so what you see matches what is provisioned.

Open the HDXCLOUD VPS / VM panel

The panel is hosted at vms.hdxclouds.com. Billing and invoices for virtual servers are handled through the client billing panel.

Explore VPS / VM Panel

External control panel

VPS / VM lifecycle management — start, stop, reinstall, and console access — is handled directly in the VPS panel.

Separate from game hosting

Minecraft hosting and VPS / VM hosting are delivered through distinct portals so each service can evolve independently.

Documentation

Terms, policies, and documentation are published at docs.hdxclouds.info.

HDXCLOUD

HDXCLOUD is an affordable Minecraft and cloud hosting brand offering transparent RAM-based plans, SSD storage, and a separate VPS / VM portal. Managed through external billing and virtualization control panels.
